SUPPLEMENT TO DAILY INTELLIGENCE REPORT
DATED FEBRUARY 24, 1933.

Anniversary of the International Unemployment Movement Day -
February 25 - possible activities of communistic elements

A scrutiny of communist handbills obtained during
the past few days and according to information from various
sources, indicates that the local Chinese Communist Party have
planned to hold demonstrations in various parts of the Settlement
on February 25 in commemoration of the Anniversary of the
International Unemployment Movement Day.

Unemployed workers of various industrial concerns
in the Western District plan to assemble between 5 and 6 a.m.
February 25 outside the N.J.K. Nos. 1 and 2 Cotton Mills, 62
Robison Road. The signal to commence proceedings will be the
firing of a cracker following which communist handbills bearing
on the occasion will be distributed and slogans shouted. This
gathering later proposes to demonstrate at the entrances of
various cotton mills in the Western District.

Information from another source indicates that a number
of unemployed workers from Western District and Chapel have
planned to meet in the vicinity of the Kawamura Memorial Tower,
junction of Robison and Ferry Roads, between 10 and 11 a.m.
February 25. This group may make an attempt to loot the
Pan Nyi Tah (潘義泰) and Zung Tah (仁泰) Rice Shops on
Robison Road near the Memorial Tower, and other rice shops
in the Western District.

A further meeting of unemployed workers will be held
near the Kawamura Memorial Tower at 5 p.m., after which they
plan to visit various food shops in the neighbourhood of
Ferry and Robison Roads and consume food for which they will
refuse to pay. In this connection it is learned that the

国际失业运动日周年纪念 -
2月25日 - 共产主义分子的可能活动

对过去几天获取的共产主义传单进行审查，并根据多方来源的情报显示，本地中国共产党计划于2月25日在租界各地举行示威，以纪念国际失业运动日周年。

西区各工业企业的失业工人计划于1933年2月25日上午5时至6时之间，在罗宾森路（Robison Road）62号的N.J.K.第一和第二棉纺厂外集合。行动开始的信号为燃放爆竹，随后将分发与此场合相关的共产主义传单并高呼口号。该集会随后计划在西区各棉纺厂入口处进行示威。

另一来源的情报显示，来自西区和闸北（Chapel，原文误拼，应为Chapei）的一些失业工人计划于1933年2月25日上午10时至11时之间，在罗宾森路与斐伦路交汇处的河村纪念塔（Kawamura Memorial Tower）附近会面。这群人可能会试图抢劫纪念塔附近罗宾森路上的潘义泰（Pan Nyi Tah）和仁泰（Zung Tah）米店，以及西区的其他米店。

另一场失业工人集会将于下午5时在河村纪念塔附近举行，之后他们计划前往斐伦路和罗宾森路附近的各家食品店，消费食物并拒绝付款。就此获悉，康纳路（Connaught Road）486号的三民（San Ming）餐馆以及

Political (2)    Feb. 24, 1933.

Bomb and threatening letter left under gate of K.K. Printing
Factory

A loaf of bread in which was a hand grenade together
with a threatening letter purporting to emanate from the
"Blood & Soul Corps" was found under the iron gates of the
K.K. Printing Factory, also known as the San Yih (三益) Company,
a Chinese concern located at 797 Kwenming Road, at 8.30 p.m.
February 23.
The letter warns the management against dealing in
Japanese goods and threatens destruction of the factory
No previous letters of this nature have been received
by this concern which also claims that at no time has it dealt
in Japanese goods.

Communist Propaganda bearing on "Anniversary of International
Unemployment Movement Day" - February 25

Copies of two communist handbills entitled respectively
"Letter to unemployed workers in Shanghai" and "Letter to unemployed
workers of Japanese cotton mills" bearing on the anniversary of the
International Unemployment Movement Day, which falls on February
25, were obtained by the Municipal Police in Western Chapel
on February 28. These handbills purport to emanate from the
Propaganda Department of the Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the
Chinese Communist Party and the Shanghai Western District
Unemployed Workers' Committee. Apart from denouncing the
political rule of the Kuomintang and the oppressions of the
Japanese Imperialists, they advocate that all unemployed
workers hold demonstrations on the occasion of this anniversary
and that groups be organized to seize clothing and rice from
shops. These groups will be called "Clothing and Rice
Distribution Groups".

Naval

Coastal Defence Gunboats - launching ceremony

The launching of two coastal Defence Gunboats "Suining"
and "Funing", constructed in the Kiangnan Dock, took place
at Kaochangmiao at 10 a.m. Feb. 23 when some 40 Chinese
including Chen Shao Kwan, Minister of Navy, were present.
The following is the description of the new vessels:-
Length - 130 feet.
Beam - 20 feet.
Draught - 7 feet.
Displacement - 300 tons.
Speed - 13 knots.
Armament - two 3" guns and 3 machine guns.

The new vessels are sister ships to the Kiangning and Haining :
launched from the same yard on October 10, 1932.

政治 (2)    1933年2月24日。

炸弹和恐吓信留在KK印刷厂大门下

1933年2月23日晚上8时30分，在昆山路（Kwenming Road）797号的一家华商企业KK印刷厂（又称三益公司）的铁门下，发现了一条面包，里面藏有一枚手榴弹，旁边还有一封据称来自“血魂团”的恐吓信。
信中警告管理层不得经营日货，并威胁要摧毁工厂。
该企业此前从未收到过此类信件，并声称其从未经营过日货。

关于“国际失业运动日”周年纪念（2月25日）的共产主义宣传

1933年2月28日，市警在西闸北（Western Chapel，原文误拼，应为Chapei）缴获了两份共产主义传单的副本，标题分别为《致上海失业工人书》和《致日本棉纺厂失业工人书》，内容涉及2月25日的国际失业运动日周年纪念。这些传单据称出自中国共产党江苏省委员会宣传部和上海西区失业工人委员会。除了谴责国民党的政治统治和日本帝国主义的压迫外，它们主张所有失业工人在此周年纪念日举行示威，并组织团体从商店中夺取衣物和大米。这些团体将被称为“衣食分配组”。

海军

海岸防御炮艇 - 下水仪式

2月23日上午10时，在江南造船坞建造的两艘海岸防御炮艇“绥宁”号和“抚宁”号在高昌庙下水，包括海军部长陈绍宽在内的约40名中国人出席了仪式。
新舰船的描述如下：-
长度 - 130英尺。
宽度 - 20英尺。
吃水 - 7英尺。
排水量 - 300吨。
航速 - 13节。
武器 - 两门3英寸火炮和3挺机枪。

新舰船是“江宁”号和“海宁”号的姊妹舰：后者于1932年10月10日从同一船厂下水。

PURPORTING TO EMANATE FROM THE PROPAGANDA SECTION OF THE
KIANGSU PROVINCIAL COMMITTEE OF THE CHINESE COMMUNIST YOUTH

To the juvenile unemployed workers throughout Shanghai:

Unite and struggle to commemorate the International
Unemployment Movement Day, February 25!

Under the rule of the imperialistic Kuomintang,
thousands and thousands of workers have been rendered jobless.
The factory managements increase the labour, lengthen the
hours, dismiss the workers and suspend business. The number
of workers driven out from the factories on to the road is
increasing. Everywhere, even in England, France or America,
is full of unemployed workers. The number of unemployed
workers in Shanghai exceeds 500,000.

The traitorous Kuomintang Government has become the
loyal running dog of the Imperialists and is spending billions
of dollars in the attack on the Red Army of labourers and
peasants. The Kuomintang is not relieving our unemployed
workers with a single cash, nevertheless it is cruelly
oppressing us, destroying our unity, arresting our leaders
and hoping that we die of starvation. Now February 25,
the day for the world unemployed workers to struggle with
the capitalists, imperialists and Kuomintang, is approaching!
Let us hold processions and stage demonstrations to commemorate
February 25!

Not a single unemployed worker can be found in the
Soviet Union and in the Soviet Districts of China, where the
8-hour working system, the 6-hour working system for juvenile
workers, unemployment relief, social insurance, etc. are in
force. This is because the Soviet Government is the
labourers' own government.

Juvenile unemployed workers, we shall never be able
to exterminate all reactionary cliques such as the Third Party,
the Abrogation Clique, the "AB" Group, etc. unless we overthrow
the imperialistic Kuomintang, because all these cliques are
assistants of the Kuomintang to murder the workers and peasants.
Only the Chinese Communist Party and the Chinese Communist
Youth League are the leaders in the struggle of the unemployed
workers. On February 25 of this year the Chinese Communist
Youth League is launching a campaign to enlist thousands and
thousands of juvenile workers and unemployed workers to join
the League for the purpose of launching a counter-attack on
the imperialistic Kuomintang.

February 25 is approaching! This year we are
facing starvation and hunger. We, unemployed workers, are
struggling with the capitalists, the Kuomintang and the
imperialists. We understand that we must be united and
besiege the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, the Social
Bureau and the capitalists demanding food supply and work.
We must employ the strength of the mass to destroy the
oppression by the imperialistic Kuomintang!

致全上海的青年失业工人：

团结起来斗争，纪念二月二十五日国际失业运动日！

在帝国主义国民党的统治下，成千上万的工人失业。工厂资方增加劳动强度，延长工时，解雇工人并停业。被赶出工厂流落街头的工人数量不断增加。到处，甚至在英国、法国或美国，都充满了失业工人。上海的失业工人人数超过50万。

叛徒国民党政府已成为帝国主义的忠实走狗，花费数十亿美元进攻工农红军。国民党没有拿出一分钱来救济我们的失业工人，反而残酷地压迫我们，破坏我们的团结，逮捕我们的领袖，希望我们饿死。现在，二月二十五日，全世界失业工人向资本家、帝国主义者和国民党斗争的日子即将来临！让我们举行游行和示威来纪念二月二十五日！

在苏联和中国的苏维埃地区，找不到一个失业工人，那里实行八小时工作制，青年工人六小时工作制，失业救济，社会保险等。这是因为苏维埃政府是劳动者自己的政府。

青年失业工人们，除非我们推翻帝国主义国民党，否则我们将永远无法消灭第三党、改组派、“AB”团等所有反动派系，因为这些派系都是国民党杀害工农的帮凶。只有中国共产党和中国共产主义青年团是失业工人斗争的领导者。今年二月二十五日，中国共产主义青年团发起运动，招募成千上万的青年工人和失业工人加入共青团，目的是对帝国主义国民党发动反击。

二月二十五日即将来临！今年我们面临饥饿和饥荒。我们失业工人正在与资本家、国民党和帝国主义作斗争。我们明白必须团结起来，包围大上海市政府、社会局和资本家，要求供应食物和工作。我们必须运用群众的力量来摧毁帝国主义国民党的压迫！

SUMMARIZED TRANSLATION OF A COMMUNIST HANDBILL ENTITLED "LETTER
TO UNEMPLOYED WORKERS IN SHANGHAI IN CONNECTION WITH THE
UNEMPLOYMENT MOVEMENT DAY ON FEBRUARY 25", PURPORTING TO EMANATE
FROM THE PROPAGANDA DEPARTMENT OF THE KIANGSU PROVINCIAL COMMITTEE
OF THE CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY, WHICH WAS OBTAINED BY THE
MUNICIPAL POLICE IN WESTERN CHAPEI ON FEBRUARY 22, 1933.

Unemployed workers throughout Shanghai,

February 25 is the Anniversary of the International
Unemployment Movement Day and it is on this date that all
employed and unemployed workers throughout the world should
rise, hold demonstrations and protest against the following
in order to secure their emancipation :-
(a) Unemployment
(b) Hunger
(c) Attack by capitalists
(d) Reactionary political rule
(e) Imperialistic warfare and attack on
Soviet Russia.

Under the iron heel of the imperialistic Kuomintang,
the labouring masses in China are exposed to the tyrannical
oppression and aggression of capitalists. The number
of unemployed workers exceeds half the total number of
workers in our country, which is due to the fact that
Chinese and foreign capitalists are either dismissing
large numbers of workers or suspending their business
operations. The employed workers who are in receipt
of reduced wages and are given heavy work are practically
on the same level as the unemployed.

Unemployed workers, we are unable to tolerate our
hardships any longer. Our only hope is to oppose the
attacks of the capitalists.

Organize and join unemployment committees.
Demand food, clothing and lodging from the Kuomintang
and capitalists.
Oppose the attack on Jehol by the Japanese
Imperialists who are also contemplating to perpetrate a
second outrage in Shanghai.
Oppose the arrest by the Kuomintang of unemployed workers
as well as anti-Japanese and anti-Imperialist masses.

The Kuomintang are rendering assistance to capitalists.
They afford no relief to unemployed workers, forbide them to
raise subscriptions, arrest and massacre unemployed workers
who are collecting contributions or participating in street
demonstrations. Moreover, they are spending billions of
dollars in the attack on the Red Armies and not a single
soldier has been despatched to fight against the Japanese.
Oppose the White Terror of the Kuomintang and demand that
the military expenditure to undertake anti-Communist campaigns
be utilized for the relief of unemployed workers.

The foreign Powers are also assisting the Japanese
to effect the partition of China. With the open assistance
of the League of Nations - especially the British and
French Imperialists - the Japanese are intensifying their
attack on Jehol and contemplating the bombardment of all China.
Confiscate Japanese goods and convert the proceeds for the
relief of unemployed workers as well as the North-Eastern
Volunteer Armies.

全上海的失业工人们：

2月25日是国际失业运动纪念日，在这一天，全世界所有在职和失业工人都应奋起，举行示威游行并抗议以下事项，以争取自身的解放：
(a) 失业
(b) 饥饿
(c) 资本家的攻击
(d) 反动政治统治
(e) 帝国主义战争及对苏维埃俄国的攻击。

在帝国主义国民党的铁蹄之下，中国劳动大众遭受着资本家的暴虐压迫与侵略。我国失业工人数量超过工人总数的一半，这是由于中外资本家要么大规模解雇工人，要么停止营业所致。那些领取减薪且承担繁重工作的在职工人，实际上与失业者处于同一境地。

失业工人们，我们再也无法忍受我们的苦难。我们唯一的希望是反对资本家的攻击。

组织并加入失业委员会。
向国民党及资本家要求食物、衣物和住所。
反对日本帝国主义者对热河的进攻，他们正图谋在上海制造第二次事变。
反对国民党逮捕失业工人以及反日、反帝民众。

国民党正在协助资本家。他们对失业工人不提供任何救济，禁止他们募集捐款，逮捕并屠杀那些筹集捐款或参加街头示威的失业工人。此外，他们耗费数十亿元用于进攻红军，却未派遣一兵一卒去抗击日本人。反对国民党的白色恐怖，要求将用于反共战役的军费转用于救济失业工人。

列强也在协助日本瓜分中国。在国际联盟——尤其是英法帝国主义者——的公开协助下，日本正加紧对热河的进攻，并图谋轰炸全中国。没收日货，并将所得款项用于救济失业工人及东北义勇军。

Brothers and sisters !

You should rise and unite at once because you are
exposed to death from hunger and cold. You should refuse
to pay land rental, oppose the demolition of straw huts and
persist in occupying the workers' quarters.

Despite your present sufferings, the Japanese
capitalists expel you from your quarters and the landowners
in cooperation with the Kuomintang order the securing of
licenses for your huts which will otherwise be demolished.
This is obvious that they are driving you to death.

On the other hand the foreign imperialists conspiring
with the Japanese imperialists as their vanguards, have
occupied several provinces and massacred thousands and
thousands of the toiling masses with the object of partition-
ing China. Instead of resisting the foreign invaders,
the Kuomintang suppress anti-Japanese and anti-Imperialist
movements, massacre revolutionary masses and despatch soldiers
to attack the Red Armies. Now is the time for you to rise
and unite. Our slogans are as follows :-

1. Organize 'Unemployed Workers Committees' with a view
to leading the unemployed in their struggles.

2. Besiege capitalistic concerns and demand work.

3. Besiege the offices of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai
and demand food, clothing, lodging and funds.

4. Compel the capitalists to issue retiring gratuities.

5. Organize 'Clothes and Rice Distribution Groups' and
seize clothes and rice from these shops.

6. Organize "Free Food Groups" and proceed to food shops
and eat without payment.

7. Organize 'Japanese Goods Investigation Groups' and confiscate
Japanese goods for the relief of the unemployed.

8. Organize Volunteer Armies and proceed to the North-East
to resist the Japanese invasions.

9. Oppose the partition of China by imperialists.

10. Expose the deceit of the Kuomintang and save the country
by increasing the air force.

11. Expel all foreign imperialists from China.

12. Overthrow the Government of the running dogs and establish
a "Democratic Political Rule."

你们应当立即起来团结一心，因为你们正面临饥寒交迫的死亡威胁。你们应当拒绝缴纳地租，反对拆除草棚，并坚持占据工人宿舍。

尽管你们目前遭受苦难，日本资本家仍将你们从宿舍中驱逐，而地主则与国民党勾结，命令你们的草棚必须取得执照，否则予以拆除。这显然表明他们是在逼你们走上绝路。

7. 组织“日货调查小组”，没收日货以救济失业者。

8. 组织志愿军，开赴东北抵抗日本侵略。

11. 将所有外国帝国主义者驱逐出中国。

12. 推翻走狗政府，建立“民主政治统治”。

親愛的弟兄姊妹們！

餓死打得要命！大火燒着眉頭了，大家趕快一条心的團結起來：

打開窗子說亮話，我們有生活做的辰光已經就困苦交關，生活重吃不消，工錢太少不够開消，現在失業了，更是打餓慌，眼前摆着死路一条。他媽的東洋老板真是狼心烏龜，要趕我們出工房，狗命的國民黨公安局同地主又要我們打照會拆草棚，媽的屁！我們窮得飯也没得吃，我們那裡來錢盖瓦房，搬家草棚拆了，竟不給住叫我們到野場馬路上去吹風淋雨等死麼？对不住！我們要反对，大家齐心起來把点顏色這些娘臘兵看看！

帝國主義國民黨地主和資本家通是一路貨，全是坏東西，弄得我們九死一生都是他們幹的好事，帝國主義实行瓜分中國要我們一輩子做他的奴隸，東洋帝國主義打先鋒一年多辰光，佔了我們幾省地方，屠殺了千萬的勞苦弟兄姊妹，國民黨替帝國主義的走狗拼命在追反日反帝運動屠殺革命民眾派兵去打抗日的工農紅軍，最近还好狗腿地講他娘的航空救國。親愛的弟兄姊妹們，大火燒着眉頭了再不團結还等什么呀！大家趕快起來：

祝賀紅軍的新勝利！

page_data.en:
Summarized translation of a communist circular entitled
"Letter to Unemployed Workers of the Unemployed Hunger
Movement Day (January 18)," purporting to emanate from
the Propaganda Department of the Kiangsu Provincial
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, which was
obtained by the Municipal Police in Western Chapel on
January 16, 1933.

January 18 is the Hunger movement day on which all
unemployed workers, poor people as well as war and famine
refugees throughout Shanghai should energetically participate
in demonstrations and demand relief, food, clothing and
lodging from the Kuomintang authorities and capitalists.

The reason why we are deprived of our daily necessities
is because Chinese and foreign capitalists and the Kuomintang
are intensifying their aggression and oppression so that
they might upkeep their wives and concubines. As the world
economic terror is getting more tense coupled with the
bombardment by Japanese forces in China, the local business
market is tottering. Consequently Chinese and foreign
capitalists intensify their attack on the workers by
reducing their wages, imposing deliberate punishment,
doubling their work, dismissing a large number of workers
and suspending business operations whereby thousands and
thousands of workers are driven to face cold and starvation.
The Kuomintang is not only rendering assistance to Chinese
and foreign capitalists but is despatching a large force
to attack the Red Armies in Soviet areas.

On the approach of the lunar New Year, the capitalists
are making preparations to celebrate the occasion whereas
unemployed workers are exposed to cold and hunger.

January 28 is fast approaching. The Kuomintang will
intensify its precautionary measures and White terror against
any agitation by the people towards the Japanese invasion in
the North-East. Unemployed workers must therefore unite
with an undaunted spirit and participate in the Hunger
Movement on January 18 despite the White terror of the
Imperialists and the Kuomintang.

(1) Oppose and do away with the White Terror of the Imperialists
and the Kuomintang.

(2) Demand food, clothing and lodging from Kuomintang organs
and capitalists.

(3) Confiscate Japanese goods and turn the proceeds to
unemployed workers and the North-Eastern Volunteer Armies.

(4) Demand that the Kuomintang issue relief to unemployed
workers from the funds earmarked for the Anti-Communist
campaign.

(5) Join the North-Eastern Volunteer Army and the Red Army.

(6) Oppose the bombardment on Jehol by Japanese imperialists.

(7) Oppose the attack on Soviet Russia and the partition
of China by the Japanese and other imperialists.

(8) Restore and safeguard by force of arms the lost territory
in the North-East.

(9) Oppose the attack on the Red Army by the Kuomintang and
cancel the 4th Bandit Suppression Campaign.

(10) Organize and join "Unemployed Workers" Committees.

一份题为《致失业工人关于失业饥饿运动日（1月18日）的信》的共产主义通告的摘要译文，该通告声称出自中国共产党江苏省委宣传部，由公共租界警务处于1933年1月16日在闸北西部（原文为Western Chapel，疑为Chapei之误）缴获。

1月18日是饥饿运动日，上海所有的失业工人、穷人以及战争和饥荒难民都应积极参加示威，并向国民党当局和资本家要求救济、食物、衣物和住所。

我们被剥夺日常生活必需品的原因，是因为中外资本家和国民党加紧侵略和压迫，以便供养他们的妻妾。随着世界经济恐慌日益紧张，加上日军在中国的轰炸，本地商业市场摇摇欲坠。因此，中外资本家通过降低工资、故意惩罚、加倍工作量、解雇大量工人和停止营业等方式，加紧对工人的攻击，致使成千上万的工人面临寒冷和饥饿。国民党不仅协助中外资本家，还派遣大批军队进攻苏区的红军。

农历新年临近，资本家正在准备庆祝这一节日，而失业工人却暴露在寒冷和饥饿之中。

1月28日迅速逼近。国民党将加强对人民针对日本入侵东北的任何煽动活动的预防措施和白色恐怖。因此，失业工人必须以无畏的精神团结起来，不顾帝国主义者和国民党的白色恐怖，参加1月18日的饥饿运动。

(1) 反对并消除帝国主义者和国民党的白色恐怖。

(2) 向国民党机构和资本家要求食物、衣物和住所。

(3) 没收日货，将所得款项交给失业工人和东北义勇军。

(4) 要求国民党从 earmarked for the Anti-Communist campaign（原文不清，意为“拨作反共战役之用”）的资金中向失业工人发放救济。

(5) 加入东北义勇军和红军。

(6) 反对日本帝国主义者轰炸热河。

(7) 反对日本及其他帝国主义者进攻苏俄和瓜分中国。

(8) 用武力恢复和保卫东北失地。

(9) 反对国民党进攻红军，取消第四次“剿匪”战役。

(10) 组织并加入“失业工人”委员会。

Summarised translation of a communist pamphlet entitled
"Resolutions concerning year-end struggles", dated 11th
December 1932, purporting to have emanated from the "Central",
which was obtained by the Municipal Police on January 9, 1933.

Under the present circumstances arising from
the world economic crisis and the financial bankruptcy of
the Chinese people, the Chinese and foreign capitalists are
oppressing the workers by resorting to means such as the
reduction of wages, prolongation of working hours, abolition
of various allowances, increase of work, dismissal of workers,
etc. etc. On the other hand, the Chinese working classes
are forced by hunger to embark on revolutionary struggles and
to resist the pressure of the Chinese and foreign capitalists.
They declare "go-slow" strikes and stage demonstrations. The
present year end will prove to be one of serious class struggles
between the Chinese and foreign capitalists and the Chinese
working class.

The Party, the League and the Labour Union must
instantly prepare for the leadership of these class struggles.
First of all, they should immediately make out concrete
outlines of the year-end struggles, which should, in each
instance, deal with the urgent demands of the workers of
every industrial concern and factory. They should
concentrate their efforts of organization on some central
industrial concerns and factories and should be prepared
for the year-end struggles by starting strikes and "go-slow"
strikes. The outline of these struggles should also
comprise the central demands of female workers, juvenile
workers and unemployed workers. It should induce them
to participate in the struggle of unemployed workers and
should elect active elements on the Committee.

The outline of the struggles should comprise
the following points:-
1) Oppose the dismissal of workers at the year-end.
2) Oppose the reduction of wages at the year-end.
3) Demand double pay at the year-end.
4) Demand holidays with pay on solar and lunar year-ends.
5) Demand issue of bonus.
6) Oppose the prolongation of working hours.
7) Demand 8-hour working day.
8) Demand immediate relief to unemployed workers.

In order to carry out and enlarge the year-
end struggles and to ensure their success, the Party, the
League and the Labour Union in various places should:-

1) Firmly lead the daily struggles of the
workers, mingle with the vast working masses, understand
their urgent demands and direct the struggle for their
benefit.

2) Combine the year-end struggles of the
employed workers with the hunger struggles of the unemployed
workers, and organize demonstration movement of unemployed
workers on January 18.

一份题为《关于年终斗争的决议》的共产主义小册子的摘要译文，日期为1932年12月11日，声称出自“中央”，由工部局警务处于1933年1月9日缴获。

在目前世界经济危机和中国人民财政破产的情况下，中外资本家正通过降低工资、延长工时、取消各种津贴、增加工作量、解雇工人等手段压迫工人。另一方面，中国工人阶级受饥饿所迫，投身于革命斗争，以抵抗中外资本家的压力。他们宣布实行“怠工”罢工并举游行示威。今年的年终将成为中外资本家与中国工人阶级之间严重的阶级斗争时期。

党、团和工会必须立即准备领导这些阶级斗争。首先，他们应立即制定年终斗争的具体大纲，在每种情况下都应处理每个企业和工厂工人的迫切要求。他们应将组织工作的重点集中在一些中心企业和工厂上，并通过发动罢工和“怠工”罢工为年终斗争做好准备。这些斗争的大纲还应包括女工、童工和失业工人的中心要求。应诱导他们参加失业工人的斗争，并在委员会中选举积极分子。

斗争大纲应包括以下几点：-
1) 反对年终解雇工人。
2) 反对年终降低工资。
3) 要求年终双薪。
4) 要求在阳历和阴历年终享受带薪假期。
5) 要求发放奖金。
6) 反对延长工作时间。
7) 要求实行八小时工作制。
8) 要求立即救济失业工人。

为了执行和扩大年终斗争并确保其成功，各地的党、团和工会应：-

1) 坚定领导工人的日常斗争，融入广大劳工群众，了解他们的迫切要求，并引导斗争以造福于他们。

2) 将受雇工人的年终斗争与失业工人的饥饿斗争结合起来，并于1月18日组织失业工人的示威运动。

"Draft of an Outline of Activities of the Unemployed
Workers in Shanghai", purporting to have emanated from
the Preparatory Committee of the "Shanghai Workers'
Committee", which was obtained by the Municipal Police
in Western District on January 9, 1933.
Chapel

The yoke of the international capitalists is responsible
for much unemployment. The number of unemployed will always
be on the increase so long as the economic terror of the
capitalists remains intensified. The majority of the
proletarian class in capitalistic countries have become
unemployed workers. China is under the rule of international
Imperialists and landlord classes. The former are intensifying
their efforts to effect the partition of China and to oppress
the inhabitants of the colonies, while the latter are imposing
heavy taxes and high standards of revenue, thereby resulting
in the closing down of many industrial concerns and the
dismissal of a large number of workers. Toiling peasants
likewise suffer from oppression. Following the Sino-Japanese
conflict in Woosung and Chapei, several tens of thousands of
workers of the San Yue Towel Factory, the Commercial Press
Ltd., the Kiangnan Arsenal and other industrial concerns have
become jobless, while a large number of refugees are now to be
found in Chapei, Kaingwan, Woosung, Chenju, Nanziang and other
war affected areas.

With the approach of the year-end, many workers are
being dismissed by Chinese and foreign capitalists and their
families are expelled from the factories and dormitories and
are exposed with the bare necessities of life during this cold
weather.

The only remedy of the unemployed workers is to unite
their own strength and struggle against the capitalists and
government authorities. Their demands are as follows :-

1. That the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and the capitalists
be requested to issue rice, cotton clothing, cotton bedding,
firewood, coal and stoves, as well as an urgent year-end
relief fund without further delay.

2. That living quarters and refugee camps be established at
once to accommodate unemployed workers and refugees.

3. That house rent, water and electricity charges as well as
other debts be not paid and that opposition be raised against
the stoppage of water and electricity supplies.

4. That factories resume operations at once; workers be paid
full wages during the period of suspension and that
compulsary measures in the labour movement be opposed.

5. That Japanese goods be confiscated and auctioned and that
the proceeds be divided among unemployed workers.

6. That the Social Bureau and the defunct General Labour Union
give publicity regarding the relief funds allotted to
unemployed workers.

7. That any arrest, search and expulsion of unemployed workers
and refugees by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, the
Shanghai Municipal Council and other military and police
authorities be opposed.

Chapel (音译)

国际资本家的枷锁造成了大量失业。只要资本家的经济恐怖持续加剧，失业人数就会不断增加。资本主义国家的大多数无产阶级已成为失业工人。中国处于国际帝国主义者和地主阶级的统治之下。前者正加紧努力以实现瓜分中国并压迫殖民地居民，而后者则征收重税和高额赋税，导致许多企业倒闭和大量工人被解雇。劳动农民同样遭受压迫。继吴淞和闸北的中日冲突之后，三友实业社毛巾厂、商务印书馆、江南兵工厂及其他企业的数万名工人失业，而在闸北、江湾、吴淞、陈菊(音译)、南翔等受战争影响的地区，现在有大量难民。

随着年终临近，许多工人被中外资本家解雇，他们的家庭被赶出工厂和宿舍，在这寒冷的天气里仅靠维持生存的最基本物资度日。

失业工人唯一的补救办法是团结自身力量，与资本家和政府当局进行斗争。他们的要求如下：-

1. 要求大上海市政府和资本家立即发放米、棉衣、棉被、柴火、煤炭和炉灶，以及紧急年终救济金。

2. 立即建立住所和难民营，以安置失业工人和难民。

3. 拒付房租、水电费及其他债务，并反对停水停电。

4. 要求工厂立即复工；在停工期间向工人支付全额工资，并反对针对劳工运动的强制措施。

5. 没收并拍卖日货，所得款项分给失业工人。

6. 要求社会局和已解散的总工会公布拨给失业工人的救济金情况。

7. 反对大上海市政府、上海公共租界工部局及其他军警当局逮捕、搜查和驱逐失业工人及难民。

Arrangements for Unemployed Day (January 18, 1933)

The general depression in business, the civil wars, the
famine, the preparations for the dismemberment of China, the
Kuomintang and capitalist terror etc. have aggravated the
problem of unemployment in China. Thousands of proletarians
are driven out of factories, and the farmers are suffering from
privations and misery. By prohibiting strikes and introducing
the law of arbitration the Kuomintang oppresses both the workers
and the unemployed. This state of affairs obliges the unemployed
to start a vigorous struggle.
To make the "Unemployed Movement" successful, the
following work must be carried out :-
Party organizations and red labour unions will each work
out a program of activity suitable to every factory, every
workshop, and every organization of the unemployed, due
consideration being given to the present situation. These
programs must cover the following points :-
1. Demand that the Kuomintang, the capitalists and the
imperialists introduce a system of insurance against
unemployment.
2. Demand that the Kuomintang Government, the local Government
and owners of factories immediately give money, food and
clothing to the unemployed.
3. Demand that "Unemployed Relief Fund" and "Insurance against
Unemployed Fund" be established by the following means :-
a) Discontinuation of the payment of the sums set apart for
financing the anti-communist campaign.
b) Discontinuation of the payment of external debts.
c) Confiscation of property of the militarists and
traitors (property of Chiang Kai Shek, Cheng Hsueh
Liang, Wang Ching Wei, T.V.Soong, Sun Fo, etc....).
d) Distribution among the unemployed of funds derived from
the loan of American wheat, the sums contributed by China
to the League of Nations, the $1,000,000 set apart for
the Lytton Commission, the $400,000 set apart for the
financing the exhibition in Chicago etc...
e) Confiscation of food supplies stored in large godowns.
f) Confiscation of Japanese goods.
4. Protest against dismissal of workers, against closing down of
factories; demand to reduce working hours; protest against
increase of working hours and reducing of wages; demand the
introduction of 8 hour working day for adults and 6 hour working
day for juvenile workers; prohibition of employment of children
under 14 years of age.
5. Protest against the expulsion of workers from their homes for
non-payment of house rent; demand that house money for the
unemployed be paid by the Government and that no rent be paid
for houses belonging to big proprietors.
6. Demand work for the unemployed.
Demonstrations of the unemployed must be systematically
organized. "Unemployed Committees", which will be permanent
organs, must be established and will be charged with the
directing of this movement. On January 18 the various organs
of the party must intensify their work in order to organize
and consolidate the "Unemployed Committees".

失业者日（1933年1月18日）安排

商业普遍萧条、内战、饥荒、瓜分中国的准备、国民党和资本家的恐怖活动等，加剧了中国的失业问题。成千上万的无产阶级被赶出工厂，农民遭受贫困和苦难。国民党通过禁止罢工和引入仲裁法来压迫工人和失业者。这种局势迫使失业者发起 vigorous (原文用词，意为有力的/激烈的) 斗争。
为了使“失业者运动”取得成功，必须开展以下工作：-
党组织和红色工会将为每个工厂、每个车间和每个失业者组织制定适合当前情况的活动计划。这些计划必须涵盖以下几点：-
1. 要求国民党、资本家和帝国主义者实行失业保险制度。
2. 要求国民党政府、地方政府和工厂主立即向失业者提供金钱、食物和衣物。
3. 要求通过以下方式建立“失业救济基金”和“失业保险基金”：-
a) 停止支付用于资助反共运动的款项。
b) 停止支付外债。
c) 没收军阀和汉奸的财产（蒋介石、张学良、汪精卫、宋子文、孙科等人的财产……）。
d) 将源自美国小麦贷款的资金、中国向国际联盟缴纳的款项、拨给李顿调查团的100万美元、拨给芝加哥博览会经费的40万美元等资金分配给失业者……
e) 没收储存在大型仓库中的粮食供应。
f) 没收日货。
4. 抗议解雇工人，抗议关闭工厂；要求缩短工作时间；抗议延长工作时间和降低工资；要求对成年工人实行八小时工作制，对童工实行六小时工作制；禁止雇用14岁以下儿童。
5. 抗议因未付房租而将工人逐出家门；要求政府为失业者支付住房费用，并且不支付属于大地主的房屋租金。
6. 要求为失业者提供工作。
必须有系统地组织失业者示威。必须建立作为永久机构的“失业者委员会”，并负责指导这一运动。1月18日，党的各机关必须加强工作，以组织和巩固“失业者委员会”。

Translation of a communist leaflet which was obtained
by the Municipal Police in the Western District on
December 30, 1932.

Dear labour friends,

The weather is cold and the end of the year
is approaching. The hardships of our livelihood are
being added to day by day, such as the increase of work
and working hours; the reduction of wages and the abolition
of bonus, night shift allowance and rice bonus. Further-
more, we are frequently beaten and scolded for trifling
errors and are even dismissed. Friends, all these are
due to the fact that the Japanese capitalists are resorting
to more cruel methods to oppress us. We are unable to do
anything.

Friends, we have toiled for the whole year and
have earned a great deal of money for the capitalists, but
still we are labouring in the same manner as ox and horse.
We have no better clothing or food to eat, yet our condition
is growing worse and worse. Look at the capitalists!
They are thoroughly enjoying themselves. They extort money
from us and live in mansions, take rich meals and ride in
motor cars. Moreover, they send millions and millions of
dollars to Japan every year to manufacture aeroplanes, big
guns and warships to slaughter labourers, peasants and
toiling Volunteer Armies in the North-East. They are
again partitioning our country-China, and are robbing the
working masses in Shanghai. Can we sit and wait for
death in face of these treatments? We must determine,
and unite to oppose the capitalists, and it is only in
this manner we can fight our way out. First, we must
hold meetings in work rooms, submit our demands, appoint
our delegates and organize the Demand Committee. In the
event that our demands are not accepted by the capitalists,
we must declare strikes. In this manner we are sure to
gain victory.

Dear labour friends! There is not much time!
We must rise up at once and demand:-
(1) One week's holiday at New Year with two weeks' pay.
(2) Issue of bonus, night shift allowance and rice bonus.
(3) Increase in the number of assistants in all work rooms.
(4) Oppose scolding, beating and dismissal of workers.

Shanghai Western District Committee
of the Chinese Communist Youth League
in Kiangsu.

December 27.

亲爱的劳工朋友们，

天气寒冷，年终将至。我们生活的艰辛与日俱增，例如工作量和工时的增加；工资的降低以及奖金、夜班津贴和米贴的取消。此外，我们常因细微过错而遭受打骂，甚至被解雇。朋友们，所有这些都是因为日本资本家正采取更残酷的手段压迫我们。我们束手无策。

朋友们，我们辛勤劳作了一整年，为资本家赚取了大量金钱，但我们仍然像牛马一样劳作。我们没有更好的衣服穿，没有更好的食物吃，然而我们的处境却每况愈下。看看那些资本家！他们正在尽情享乐。他们从我们身上榨取钱财，住在豪宅里，吃着丰盛的饭菜，坐着汽车。此外，他们每年向日本输送数百万美元，用于制造飞机、大炮和战舰，以屠杀东北地区的劳工、农民和义勇军。他们再次瓜分我们的国家——中国，并抢劫上海的劳动群众。面对这样的待遇，我们能坐以待毙吗？我们必须下定决心，团结起来反对资本家，只有这样才能杀出一条生路。首先，我们必须在车间举行会议，提出我们的要求，推选代表并组织“要求委员会”。如果我们的要求不被资本家接受，我们就必须宣布罢工。这样我们就一定能取得胜利。

亲爱的劳工朋友们！时间不多了！我们必须立即起身，要求：
(1) 新年放假一周，并发放两周工资。
(2) 发放奖金、夜班津贴和米贴。
(3) 增加各车间辅助工人的数量。
(4) 反对辱骂、殴打和解雇工人。

江苏中国共产主义青年团
上海西区委员会

Dear labour friends, 


The weather is cold and the end of the year 
is approaching. The hardships of our livelihood are 
being added to day by day, such as the imrease of work 
and working hours; the reduction of wages and the abolition

more, we sare frequently beaten and scolded for trifling 
errors and are even dismissed. Friends, all these are

anything. 


Friends, we have toiled for the whole year and
